prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Beartic (툰베어) personified, ice type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her wearing the costume chosen in SCENE — a daring adult costume version of her source creature, as worn to a costume party, convention or photo shoot. In this cut her species shows in the outfit itself: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image.

SETTING: a stylised stage, editorial or fantasy set, not bound to a real year — still one real adult woman in a believable space, no creatures.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: the grand staircase of an old castle
Outfit: An adult Beartic hooded mini dress in white plush fabric, with rounded bear ears on the hood, a deep V neckline over a fitted strapless inner bodice and an ice-blue faceted collar trim.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters away from the camera, her face turned away with her body too — only her cheek line and the edge of her profile show; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
GAZE: she looks out of the window.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.
Scene note: A silver snowflake clasp on the stone balustrade catches the cool light filtering through tall stained glass.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more shoulder, neckline and upper-back exposure inside the crop; cover the chest
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely into the costume SCENE describes. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. The costume must read at first glance as that creature's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit; she is a real woman in a costume — never the creature itself, its face on her face, fur or scales on her skin, a logo or readable text.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
